description: The pie chart represents the distribution of difficulty levels in a dataset. There are five slices corresponding to different difficulty levels: Medium, Hard, Easy, Very hard, and Very easy. The Medium difficulty level has the largest slice, accounting for 51.8% of the chart, and is colored in light red. The Hard difficulty level is the second largest, making up 25.7% of the chart, and is colored in light blue. The Easy difficulty level is represented by a green slice, comprising 11.2% of the chart. The Very hard difficulty level is shown in a light orange color and constitutes 6.5% of the chart. Lastly, the Very easy difficulty level is the smallest slice, colored in light purple, and represents 3.7% of the chart. The chart includes a legend in the upper left corner, which matches the colors to the difficulty levels. The percentages are labeled inside the corresponding slices, and the chart is not ordered by size.
